headline: Brazilian Stocks Fall as Candidate Flávio Bolsonaro Flees to Miami
summary: Brazil's Bovespa index fell up to 2.8%, with individual stocks dropping as much as 12%, following news that presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro fled to Miami despite a court order to surrender his passport.
why: Political instability in Latin America's largest economy directly affects investor sentiment, foreign capital flows, and domestic equity valuations.

impacts.name: Brazilian Equities
impacts.why: Heightened political turmoil sparked widespread equity selling on the B3 exchange.

why_moved: Uncertainty surrounding a high-profile political figure fleeing the country triggered a sharp sell-off in Brazilian equities.
